findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ping, traceroute, port_map, search_ip, syslog_search, eventlog_search, log_severity_summary, syslog_facets, agent_services, agent_processes, alerts_list, alerts_history, arp_table, device_metric_summary, agent_disk_usage · Private data: get_network_entity_info, ping, eve_get, netflow_raw_search · Public sink: ping, traceroute, port_map, snmp_test, snmp_walk_run, agent_services, agent_processes, alerts_list, alerts_history, top_bandwidth, arp_table, device_metric_summary, agent_disk_usage · Destructive: search_ip, eve_search, syslog_facets, snmp_test, snmp_walk_run, agent_processes, agent_disk_usage, capture_list.
